description: An ordinal a is below omega^omega exactly when every exponent in CNF omega a is below omega.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.OrdinalPowers.below_omega_power_omega_iff.{u} (a : Ordinal.{u}) :
  a < Ordinal.omega0 ^ Ordinal.omega0 ↔ ∀ p ∈ Ordinal.CNF Ordinal.omega0 a, p.1 < Ordinal.omega0
